notifications.subject: Load Pocket Advisory Declaration
notifications.body:
MISO has issued a Load Pocket Advisory Declaration for Amite South due to:
    Load Pocket Advisory Reason: 5+ hours of N-1/G-1 insufficiency in the 24 hour operating day with any magnitude deficit

Start: 11/02/2026 10:00 EST
End: 11/02/2026 23:00 EST

Affected Region(s):
     South Region - EES, CLEC, LEPA, LAGT

This public notification is for awareness only. Impacted entities receive detailed instructions and information via the Operator Interface.
